templateCommits:
4b8502a refactor: separate template and project code for easier sync [90m(18/01/2026)[0m
  Split 5 aggregation files into template + project parts to prevent
  merge conflicts during template sync:
  - features/index.ts -> index.template.ts + index.ts
  - NavLinks.tsx -> NavLinks.template.tsx + NavLinks.tsx
  - collections/index.ts -> index.template.ts + index.ts
  - routes/index.ts -> index.template.ts + index.ts
  - apis.ts -> apis.template.ts + apis.ts
  
  Template code lives in *.template.ts files (synced from template).
  Project code imports from template and adds customizations.
  Added project files to .template-sync.json ignoredFiles.
  
  Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

f574b79 fix: use ID utilities instead of direct ObjectId construction [90m(18/01/2026)[0m
  Replaced `new ObjectId(variable)` with `toDocumentId()` and `toQueryId()`
  utilities to properly handle both ObjectId and UUID formats:
  
  - Feature request handlers: use toDocumentId() for authorId and requestedBy
  - Report batch handlers: use toQueryId() for query operations
  
  Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

70da8a3 feat: add local template path support for faster sync [90m(17/01/2026)[0m
  When templateLocalPath is configured in .template-sync.json, uses local
  git clone instead of network clone for much faster sync operations.
  Falls back to remote clone if local path is invalid.
  
  Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

6cb99e8 feat: add duplicate detection and token usage tracking to investigate-bugs [90m(17/01/2026)[0m
  After investigating a bug report, the script now queries reports from +/- 2 days
  and asks Claude to identify duplicates based on description/error similarity.
  Duplicates are marked in the database and automatically excluded from future runs.
  
  Also adds token usage tracking to display input/output tokens and cost per
  investigation and in the final summary.
  
  Changes:
  - Add duplicateOf field to ReportDocument for tracking duplicate relationships
  - Add findReportsInTimeRange() and markReportAsDuplicate() database methods
  - Update findUninvestigatedReports() to exclude duplicates
  - Add detectDuplicates() function using Claude to identify similar reports
  - Display token count and cost per investigation and in summary
  - Rename --limit to --limit-reports for clarity
  
  Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
